body:
NameExoWorld: A global project in celebration of 100 years of IAU NameExoWorlds offers the opportunity for all countries in the world to give a name to one exoplanets and its hosting star

NameExoWorlds National Committee in Jordan

WASP-80 b is a gas giant exoplanet that orbits a K-type star. Its mass is 0.538 Jupiters, it takes 3.1 days to complete one orbit of its star, and is 0.0344 AU from its star. Its discovery was announced in 2012.

Star

  • Identification: WASP-80
  • Type: orange, dwarf
  • Constellation: Aquila

Planet

Identification: WASP-80 b

PLANET TYPE Gas Giant DISCOVERY DATE 2012
MASS 0.538 Jupiters PLANET RADIUS 0.999 x Jupiter
ORBITAL RADIUS 0.0344 AU ORBITAL PERIOD 3.1 days
ECCENTRICITY 0.0 DETECTION METHOD Transit
